label: E7-2 Modular ESAP OLT
description: Calix E7-2 AXOS Ethernet Service Access Platform: a 1RU shelf with two universal line-card slots that holds 16 GPON ports when fully populated. This spec counts one GPON-8 r2 card in slot 1 - 8 GPON OIM ports (gpon1/1-8, 64 ONTs each) plus that card's own 2x 10GE SFP+, 2x 10GE XFP and 4x GE SFP ports; two GPON-8 r2 cards fill the shelf for 16 PON ports and 1024 ONTs at 1:64.
